The Petitioners have approached this Court for quashing FIR No.427/2019 dated 02.09.2019,
registered at Police Station Bharat Nagar for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the Parties have entered into an amicable settlement.
2. The Respondent No.2/complainant is not present in Court today.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J AUGUST 12, 2024 S. Zakir
